name: Reaction-Bot
description: A Telegram reaction bot built with Pyrogram that auto-reacts to messages in groups and channels. Uses MongoDB to store settings and supports easy Heroku deployment.

OWNER_ID.description: Fill Here Your Owner User Id

MONGO_URL.description: Get a mongodb url from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

PRIVATE_MODE.description: true = only the owner (and ALLOWED_USERS) can use the bot

ALLOWED_USERS.description: Extra user ids allowed to use the bot, separated by space or comma

CLONE_DAYS.description: Days a cloned bot stays active (0 = lifetime)

DB_NAME.description: Name of the MongoDB database used by the bot
